overall_goal: Prepare the garlic and stir the cooking ingredients.

goals.description: Extract and peel the first batch of garlic cloves.
goals.rationale: The person opens the garlic bag, peels several cloves, discards a moldy one, and clears the scraps.
The person continues to pick up and peel more garlic cloves, placing the peeled cloves on the cutting board and scraps in the bowl.

goals.description: Trim the ends off the peeled garlic cloves.
goals.rationale: The person uses a knife to slice the ends off the peeled garlic cloves and discards the ends into the bowl.
The person slices the garlic into smaller pieces, switches to a larger knife, and repeatedly chops and gathers the garlic until finely minced.

goals.description: Transfer the chopped garlic to a plate.
goals.rationale: The person uses the knife to move the minced garlic from the cutting board onto a small blue plate.

goals.description: Stir the ingredients in the wok.
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to stir the onions cooking in the wok.
